description: List the looks (reference images) of a character with id, status (pending, processing, completed, failed), scene_prompt and image url when ready. Same as `clipugc images list --character <id>`. Also the poll call for generate_image and create_character. Costs no credits.

character.description: Character id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

name: list_images
title: List character looks
